    SELECT o_orderkey, o_orderpriority
    FROM orders
    WHERE o_orderdate >= '1993-07-01'::date
      AND o_orderdate < '1993-10-01'::date
),
filtered_lineitems AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l_orderkey
    FROM lineitem
    WHERE l_commitdate < l_receiptdate
)
SELECT
    vo.o_orderpriority,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM
    valid_orders vo
JOIN
    filtered_lineitems fl ON vo.o_orderkey = fl.l_orderkey
GROUP BY
    vo.o_orderpriority
ORDER BY
    vo.o_orderpriority;
